title: Feature request - settings for Bluetooth devices
symptom: The thread discusses a feature request to split the selection of Bluetooth device entries for devices like bluereader, limitter, bluecon, and sweetreader. Currently, the device is detected while connecting, which can cause problems later, such as special settings for specific devices only being visible if the device has a right connection, and checks within the recollection depending on connection status.
evidence_quote: I would like to discuss to split the selection of the bluetooth device entry for bluereader, limitter, bluecon, sweetreader and so on.
